elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to both Parties)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... The cap is mutual"

elements.element: Cap basis limb (a): Fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — basis is 'all amounts', not Fees

elements.element: Cap expressed as the greater of (a) and (b)
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000"
Clause 21.1 addresses only the aggregate cap; no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages appears in the redlined text

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims"; 21.3 "a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: 21.3 "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: 21.3 "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section"
"the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" — basis is all amounts, and a preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor is added

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct

reasons: Preferred limb (a) requires 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'; the redline substitutes 'all amounts paid or payable by Customer', a different and broader basis that the playbook expressly does not treat as satisfying the fees measure. Use 'Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms' instead.

The preferred level's mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is absent from the clause as rendered; nothing in 21.1 or 21.3 excludes indirect, consequential, special or incidental damages, so the preferred bargain is incomplete.

Fallback is also unmet as drafted: it calls for a straight 12 months' fees cap, whereas the text both changes the basis to 'all amounts' and layers on the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor (mixing levels and exceeding the fallback threshold).

Minimality fails only on the unnecessary broadening from the defined term Fees to 'all amounts'; fixing the illusory 'first Order Form' scope was needed, but the amount-basis expansion goes beyond what completing the preferred level required.

Carve-outs, mutuality and the payment-obligations carve-out are already satisfied by existing 21.1/21.3 language and were correctly left untouched; no dangling terms or contradictions were introduced.
